name: AIS-Based Global Dredging Footprint Pipeline
description: A 7-step computational pipeline for detecting and quantifying dredging vessel activities using AIS tracking data and estimating the resulting carbon perturbation via an Ocean Circulation Inverse Model (OCIM). Combines Isolation Forest, Gaussian Mixture Model, DBSCAN, global grid computation of swept-volume ratios, seabed lithology integration, carbon release index calculation, and Jdredge remapping to OCIM2-48L for steady-state pCO2 perturbation modelling.
